ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel ratio across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity regions occupy the central and distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity pixels are concentrated at the basal hinge and along the trailing edges. Multiple discrete, low-intensity circular mottling clusters are scattered within the high-intensity fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 to 15 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex trailing edge curve terminating in sharp distal points. The leading edges show moderate convexity tapering towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the interior regions of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent diagonal linear dark streak is visible on the mid-left lobe, and several thinner parallel vertical linear marks are visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular high-contrast texture clusters (barnacle colonization) are located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark, triangular pigmentation field at the central peduncle junction that creates a high-contrast boundary against the adjacent white ventral surface.
